00044 #include "ugen_JuceTimerDeleter.h"
00045 
00046 JuceTimerDeleter::JuceTimerDeleter() throw()
00047 {
00048     startTimer(1);
00049 }
00050 
00051 JuceTimerDeleter::~JuceTimerDeleter() throw()
00052 {
00053     stopTimer();
00054     flush();
00055 }
00056 
00057 void JuceTimerDeleter::deleteInternal(SmartPointer* internalToDelete) throw()
00058 {
00059     toDelete.add(internalToDelete);
00060 }
00061 
00062 void JuceTimerDeleter::timerCallback()
00063 {
00064     toDelete.getLock().enter();
00065     
00066     for(int i = 0; i < toDelete.size(); i++)
00067     {
00068         SmartPointer* internalToDelete = toDelete.getUnchecked(i);      
00069         //if(internalToDelete->getRefCount() >= 0)  // hack for some other bug? how could a refCount get to -1?
00070             delete internalToDelete;
00071     }
00072     
00073     toDelete.clearQuick();
00074     toDelete.getLock().exit();
00075 }
00076 
00077 void JuceTimerDeleter::flush() throw()
00078 {
00079     timerCallback();
00080 }
00081 
00082
